scope: Known embedding benchmark, not a complete realistic model

embedding.group_homomorphism: (A,B,z) -> diag(z^-2 A,z^3 B), A in SU(3), B in SU(2), z in U(1)
embedding.weight_convention: Fundamental-index occupation vectors; Cartan generators traceless; 10 = exterior square of fundamental

scalar_sector: deferred to vacuum investigator; campaign restricts initial analysis to a real adjoint 24
handoff_questions: Does a real adjoint VEV proportional to diag(2,2,2,-3,-3) have exactly the desired continuous stabilizer?
What stabilizer does the unsuitable diag(1,1,1,1,-4) control have?
Which renormalizable adjoint invariants support the desired stationary point, and what stability claims can be established?
Keep electroweak Higgs fields, realistic Yukawa couplings, neutrino masses and full phenomenology explicitly deferred.
